bias.label: Rejected at 3,685-3,697; leaning down while under 3,640 into Monday

event: Gold is closed or closing for the weekend. Mon 30 Nov: month end, and the open can gap. Tue 1 Dec: US ISM manufacturing and JOLTS, 17:00 SAST. Wed 2 Dec: ADP jobs, 15:15 SAST. Thu 3 Dec: ISM services, 17:00 SAST. Fri 4 Dec: US jobs report, 15:30 SAST. Fed decision Wed 9 Dec (meeting 8-9 Dec), with a 25 bp hike about 95-99% priced.

bullets.title: Rally faded
bullets.text: Spot gold topped near 3,685 (futures 3,693.90) on Friday, then pared gains to 3,622.71 by 18:05 SAST; no later price or Friday close was found, so the close is UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: First weekly gain
bullets.text: Gold is set for its first weekly rise in three weeks, about 3%, after Wednesday's 15-month low near 3,426 (Kitco/Reuters).

bullets.title: Fed hike priced
bullets.text: Futures show a 95-99% chance of a 25 bp hike on 9 Dec and about 64-66% for more in January, after core PCE of 3.3% and Q3 GDP revised to 4.3%.

bullets.title: Dollar and yields
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 103.7-103.8, just off Monday's 20-month high of 104.53, and the US 10-year yield was 4.918% on Friday morning (FinanceFeeds, CNBC).

bullets.title: Short-covering bounce
bullets.text: Analysts call the move short-covering and bargain buying, and say rallies toward 3,750-3,800 could attract sellers (Zain Vawda via IUX).

bullets.title: Trend still down
bullets.text: Price is below the 21-day average near 3,833 with RSI about 39, so the daily trend is still bearish (TMGM).

bullets.title: Busy week ahead
bullets.text: US ISM, JOLTS, ADP and the Friday jobs report come before the Fed, so expect bigger swings from Tuesday.

buy.title: Buy plan: 3,600-3,606 holds (counter-trend)
look: This is against the daily downtrend and today's rejection, so use half size or skip it.
A slow dip into 3,600-3,606 with long lower wicks, not a fast drop through it.
A higher low on the 15M chart and a close back above 3,612.
The dollar index staying under 103.9 and US yields not rising.
Take some profit at 3,623 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Buying at Monday's open. A weekend gap can jump straight past your stop, so wait for the first hour to settle.
A 1H close under 3,595 means 3,558-3,567 is next. Step aside.
Strong US data on Tuesday or hawkish Fed talk can push gold lower fast.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That turns a small loss into a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: retest of 3,631-3,640 fails (with the main trend)
look: Price bounces back into 3,631-3,640 and stalls there.
A clear 15M rejection wick or a bearish close back under 3,625.
A 1H lower high under 3,640 with momentum fading.
The dollar or US yields firming again, which fits the Fed hike pricing.
Take some profit at 3,606 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Chasing the drop at the current price, right above 3,600 support. Wait for the retest.
A 1H close above 3,648 means buyers are back and 3,664-3,671 is next. Do not fight it.
Selling straight into Monday's open. Weekend headlines on the Fed, tariffs or the Middle East can gap price; wait for the retest.
Re-entering again and again after being stopped out. One attempt, then step away.
